channel.title: InYourBones Daily Music News
channel.description: Top 5 daily music stories handpicked by InYourBones

item.title: Raye Wins 2026 Mercury Prize
item.description: RAYE takes home the 2026 Mercury Prize! 🏆 A huge moment for a one-of-a-kind voice—and a very well-deserved win. 🎶

item.title: Jorja Smith, Corinne Bailey Rae, FLO, & More Cover Amy Winehouse With Mark Ronson At Back To Black 20 Tribute
item.description: A soulful salute to Amy Winehouse 🎙️ Jorja Smith, Corinne Bailey Rae, FLO and more joined Mark Ronson for a special *Back to Black* tribute.

item.title: Chappell Roan Duets With Surprise Guest Christina Aguilera At Super Graphic Spectuacular
item.description: Pop princesses, unite! Chappell Roan and Christina Aguilera shared a surprise duet at the Super Graphic Spectacular—and the crowd went wild ✨🎤

item.title: Sonic Temple Secures Iron Maiden, blink-182, Korn
item.description: Sonic Temple just raised the volume 🔥 Iron Maiden, blink-182, and Korn are heading to the festival—three huge reasons to bring your loudest singalong! 🤘

item.title: Queens Of The Stone Age Play “Where The Goth Girls At?” On Fallon, Announce 2027 Tour
item.description: Queens of the Stone Age brought “Where The Goth Girls At?” to Fallon—and they’re taking it on tour in 2027 🖤🎸
